presses and drags again near the top edge: no new stroke, instead the whole window moves (down at 01.8, right at 03.0, again at 04.0; window frame and traffic-light buttons shift against the desktop)

decisive: 00:01.5-00:04.0: pressing and dragging near the canvas top moves the whole window (down, then right) and no line is drawn
